about: Country pages for the Veteran Resource Guide (guide.vethomeguard.org/world/). Every number below was read on the official page named in its source, on the date in checked_on. Sources are government bodies, national public bodies or UN/WHO agencies. A charity appears only where a government page names it, and the government page is cited. A published number is not telephone-confirmed. Edit this file, then run python3 scripts/build_public.py.
review_method: official page read in full through a fetch tool; no agency was telephoned

fmp.name: VA Foreign Medical Program (FMP)
fmp.covers: Medically necessary care outside the United States for a VA-rated, service-connected disability, for a condition associated with and held to be aggravating a service-connected disability, or as part of Veteran Readiness and Employment (VR&E). FMP does not cover care or supplies received in or from the U.S. or U.S. territories.
fmp.letter: Veterans with a VA-rated, service-connected condition can get an FMP benefits letter by signing in to VA.gov and opening Letters from the My VA menu. Providers can use the letter to file claims. If you already paid for care, you can file the claim yourself.
fmp.claims: Claims can be filed online, by email to HAC.FMP@va.gov, or by mail to VHA Office of Integrated Veteran Care, Foreign Medical Program (FMP), PO Box 200, Spring City, PA 19475.
fmp.hours: Monday through Friday, 8:05 a.m. to 6:45 p.m. ET
fmp.claims_source_title: VA.gov: How to file a VA Foreign Medical Program claim

us_canada.note: The current FMP page shows a "U.S. and Canada" line, but its number did not appear in the page text we read. These two numbers come from VA's FMP Guide, revised April 5, 2023: 1-877-345-8179 toll-free in the United States and Canada, and 303-331-7590 as the program's direct phone.

vcl.name: Veterans Crisis Line from outside the United States

regions.label: Central and South America and the Caribbean (SOUTHCOM)

notes: Each number is assigned to a different U.S. Department of Defense area of responsibility. Off base, dial the number with the U.S. country code; on base, dial DSN 988.
If the number for your region does not work, the Veterans Crisis Line says to try one of the other numbers.
Off base outside the United States, Canada or Mexico, your carrier may charge international rates even for a toll-free number.
Online chat works anywhere with an internet connection. Texting 838255 works from abroad only on a U.S. carrier with an international plan that allows texts to U.S. short codes.
vcl.source_title: Veterans Crisis Line: Military Crisis Line and calling from overseas

manila.name: VA Manila Regional Office (Philippines)
manila.note: VA runs the Manila VA Outpatient Clinic, 1501 Roxas Boulevard, Pasay City, open Monday to Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. The clinic and FMP cover care for VA-rated, service-connected disabilities.

countries.name: Canada
countries.vcl_note: In Canada, 988 reaches Canada's own 9-8-8 Suicide Crisis Helpline, which helps anyone in Canada. To reach the U.S. Veterans Crisis Line itself, use online chat, or try another regional number below.
countries.fmp_note: VA's FMP Guide (revised April 5, 2023) says inquiries and claims from veterans living in Canada go to Foreign Countries Operations, Ottawa: toll-free 1-888-996-2242. Confirm this with FMP before you send a claim.
